title: Picking an attention variant
summary: Choose MHA, MQA, GQA, or MLA from a cache and quality constraint.

choices.text: Multi-head attention: a distinct key head and value head for every query head.
Multi-query attention: a single key head and a single value head, shared by all queries.
Multi-head latent attention: keys and values compressed into one latent per token, which is what the cache stores, then up-projected back to every head.
Grouped-query attention: query heads clustered into groups, with one key/value head stored per group.
